summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the 3 new features (Live myDATA infra, ΓΑΚ/ΕΑΚ + portal deep links, One-Screen Dashboard toggle). Backend: 10/10 new pytest cases green (mydata status mock/live, test-connection Greek 400 errors, sync mock/live/re-sync recovery, issue in mock, dashboard extended fields with obligations sorted, cases CRUD with gak/eak/gak_year). Frontend: One-Screen toggle works end-to-end (all 8 requested testids OS-*, label flips 'One-Screen προβολή' ↔ 'Κλασική προβολή', persists across page reload via localStorage). Settings AADE section: badge 'Προσομοίωση (Mock)', env select present, 'Δοκιμή σύνδεσης ΑΑΔΕ' button shows correct Greek toast when no creds. /mydata shows 'Λειτουργία Προσομοίωσης (Mock)' + counts (3 εκκρεμή / 7 σταλμένα). Portal links all correct: eparavolo→gsis.gr, olomeleia→portal.olomeleia.gr, solon→extapps.solon.gov.gr. Case detail has case-gak-display + edit-gak-button + solon-link; edit dialog (gak-input/eak-input/gak-year-input) saves and updates display to 'ΓΑΚ 555 · ΕΑΚ 88/2026' with Greek toast 'Τα στοιχεία ΣΟΛΩΝ ενημερώθηκαν'. New Case dialog has case-gak-input/case-eak-input/case-gak-year-input. Settings cleaned up: aade_user_id/subscription_key empty, mode=mock, connected=false at end of run (verified via curl).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_mydata.py cleanly separates live vs mock branches via mydata_ready(settings). Failure path in sync correctly persists mydata_status='failed' + mydata_error and raises HTTPException(400) — good UX for the frontend to show a Greek toast.
mydata_client.build_invoices_doc_xml correctly validates company AFM and client AFM BEFORE any HTTP call to AADE — fast-fail with Greek business errors. Good.

routes_dashboard.py summary endpoint is ~117 lines and mixes chart building, obligations, and advice in a single function — still readable, but obligations construction could be extracted into helper for testability if it grows.
routes_settings.PUT computes mydata_connected based on presence of both aade_user_id and aade_subscription_key — matches mydata_ready() logic. Consistent.

MyData.jsx filters out draft invoices from the table (i.status !== 'draft'), so 'pending' myDATA rows can only exist for already-issued invoices. This is intentional and consistent with the UX ('you can't send a draft to myDATA'), but the pending_count in the header can include drafts — very minor cosmetic discrepancy worth documenting but not a bug.
OneScreenDashboard toggle correctly persists to localStorage under 'nomos_view_mode' (verified: reload keeps one-screen active until manually toggled back).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ clients + TEST_ IssueMock invoice + TEST_ SyncClient invoice (used for sync mock/live/re-sync tests) + TEST_SOLON case (created, updated with gak=999/eak=77, deleted). Also modified case ΥΠΘ-2026-0003 gak/eak to '555 / 88 / 2026' via UI edit dialog — main agent may reset this if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (Live myDATA infra with settings-driven mock/live switch, ΓΑΚ/ΕΑΚ + government portal links, One-Screen Dashboard) are production-ready. Backend AADE settings were RESTORED to empty (mock mode) at end of tests — verified via /api/mydata/status returning mode=mock. To run backend tests: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_new_features.py -v -o addopts=''`. Live-mode AADE test uses fake credentials and expects graceful 400 with Greek text — this is CORRECT behavior when AADE returns 401 to bogus keys.
